answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Taqleed & Fighi Schools Question ID: 2114 Country: India Title: Are the Hanafi more in the world, or Ahl-e-Sunnat or Wahhabi? Question: Are the Hanafi more in the world, or Ahl-e-Sunnat or Wahhabi? Ass salam aalye kum duniya me jada Hanafi hai, Ahle Sunnat, Ya Wahhabi W/s Answer ID: 2114 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 539/539=L) Those who followed the way of the S ahaba (Companions) they are Ahl-e-Sunnah Wal-Jamat : اھل السنۃ والجماعۃ ھم الذین التزموا طریق السنۃ التی کانت علیھا الصحابۃ رضی اللہ عنھم قبل بدوّ البدعات کالاعتزال والتشیع والرفض وغیرھا (التعریفات الفقھیۃ فی آخر قواعد الفقہ: 197) So, the followers of all imams are part of Ahl-e-Sunnah Wal-Jamat . And they are visibly in majority. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
